item.title: F1: THE MOVIE Producer Lewis Hamilton Reveals HUGE Sequel Update: "I Know What We Could Do Better"
item.description: Legendary Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton has shared an update on the F1: The Movie sequel, confirming that his main focus is developing a follow-up that's even better than the first instalment.

item.title: SCARPETTA Interview: Ariana DeBose & Bobby Cannavale On Lucy And Peter's Father-Daughter Bond (Exclusive)
item.description: Scarpetta stars Ariana DeBose and Bobby Cannavale talk to us about the new Prime Video series, explaining how they approached their roles and the dynamic between their characters.

item.title: THE LORD OF THE RINGS: THE HUNT FOR GOLLUM Is Casting Two Lead Female Roles - But Who Are They?
item.description: As work continues on The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum, a new report reveals that filmmaker Andy Serkis is looking to cast two key female roles in the latest Middle-earth-set prequel.

item.title: DREDD Star Karl Urban On Potentially Reprising The Role Ahead Of Taika Waititi's Planned Reboot
item.description: A direct sequel to 2012's Dredd remains highly unlikely, but star Karl Urban is keen to return as the iconic Mega-City One lawman - even with a reboot on the horizon...

item.title: JONAH HEX Star Megan Fox Hailed As An Ageless Goddess In Risqué Return To Instagram
item.description: Transformers star Megan Fox has broken the internet after returning to Instagram, and fans can't quite get their heads around just how incredible she looks 19 years after that movie's release.
